nike.scope: Brand-specific public product data (third-party; not first-party brand data)
nike.name: Adidas vs Nike (retail product listings)
nike.contains: Product names, INR sale prices, ratings and review counts for Nike listings, scraped 2020-04.
nike.does_not_contain: Ad spend, impressions, clicks, conversions, unit costs, inventory or actual units sold.
nike.used_for: Nike product names, prices, popularity signal (reviews/ratings).
nike.limitations: Snapshot from 2020; discount field is zero throughout; review count is only a popularity proxy.
nike.notes: Filtered to brand, de-duplicated, one representative SKU per category chosen deterministically by public popularity; prices in INR; popularity = percentile rank of the public popularity field.

samsung.scope: Brand-specific public product data (third-party; not first-party brand data)
samsung.name: Flipkart Mobile Dataset
samsung.contains: Smartphone models with RAM/ROM, INR sale price, discount %, ratings, rating counts and a relative sales index.
samsung.does_not_contain: Ad spend, impressions, clicks, conversions, unit costs or Samsung first-party sales.
samsung.used_for: Samsung phone names, prices, discounts, popularity signal.
samsung.limitations: Flipkart listing view only; 'sales' is an unexplained relative index.
samsung.notes: Filtered to brand, de-duplicated, one representative SKU per category chosen deterministically by public popularity; prices in INR; popularity = percentile rank of the public popularity field.

lenovo.scope: Brand-specific public product data (third-party; not first-party brand data)
lenovo.name: Flipkart India Laptops under ₹75,000
lenovo.contains: Laptop names, processor, RAM/SSD, INR price and Flipkart popularity rank.
lenovo.does_not_contain: Ad spend, clicks, conversions, costs, inventory, or Lenovo first-party sales. Only laptops under ₹75,000.
lenovo.used_for: Lenovo laptop names, prices, popularity signal (rank).
lenovo.limitations: Single marketplace, price-capped range; no enterprise/ThinkPad-tier pricing.
lenovo.notes: Filtered to brand, de-duplicated, one representative SKU per category chosen deterministically by public popularity; prices in INR; popularity = percentile rank of the public popularity field.

lv.scope: Brand-specific public product data (third-party; not first-party brand data)
lv.name: Louis Vuitton product price list — France (Data Boutique)
lv.publisher: DBQ / Data Boutique on Hugging Face
lv.contains: Product titles, categories and EUR list prices from the French LV website (2023-11-17).
lv.does_not_contain: Ad data, unit costs, sales, inventory. Prices converted at a fixed demo rate (1 EUR = ₹90).
lv.used_for: LV product names, categories, price tiers.
lv.limitations: Scraped catalog snapshot; the dataset card states the licence as unknown, so it is used only for product names/prices context; no sales or popularity signal.
lv.notes: Filtered to brand, de-duplicated, one representative SKU per category chosen deterministically by public popularity; prices in INR; popularity = percentile rank of the public popularity field.

supreme.scope: Brand-specific public product data (third-party; not first-party brand data)
supreme.name: Sneakers & Streetwear Sales (2022)
supreme.type: Public transaction sample (provenance not documented by publisher)
supreme.contains: 353 transactions across streetwear brands; only 32 Supreme rows, all one product type (hoodie), USD prices, 2022-01..08.
supreme.does_not_contain: Any Supreme product other than hoodies, ad data, costs or inventory. Cannot be verified as Supreme's own sales.
supreme.used_for: Supreme hoodie price/volume signal. Other Supreme SKUs are DEMO catalog assumptions (labelled).
supreme.limitations: Tiny sample; unverified origin. Remaining SKUs are illustrative, not sourced.
supreme.notes: Filtered to brand, de-duplicated, one representative SKU per category chosen deterministically by public popularity; prices in INR; popularity = percentile rank of the public popularity field.

marketing.scope: Generic marketing data (not brand-specific; anonymised advertiser)
marketing.name: Sales Conversion Optimization (Facebook ad campaigns)
marketing.publisher: Kaggle (loveall) — anonymised ad data from an unnamed company 'xyz'
marketing.license: Other (specified in the Kaggle dataset description)
marketing.contains: Per-ad impressions, clicks, spend, enquiries and approved (purchase) conversions, with age/gender/interest segment.
marketing.does_not_contain: Any brand identity, product, price, margin, inventory, or revenue. Not from any of the five demo brands.
marketing.limitations: 1,143 ads from one advertiser, single quarter; weak-to-moderate signal; USD spend.
marketing.notes: Cleaned (null/neg/click>impression checks); rate features added at training time.
